Small Business Accounting | Home Page | Elevation Tax Home Who is Elevation Tax? Elevation Tax is a trusted financial partner dedicated to empowering small business entrepreneurs by removing the stress of accounting and back-office operations. With a mission rooted in delivering seamless, cloud-based financial solutions, Elevation Tax helps clients focus on growing their businesses while a team of expert professionals handle the numbers with precision and care. Guided by values of client-centered service, teamwork, honesty, innovation, and dependability, Elevation Tax builds lasting partnerships through proactive strategies and personalized support. As a forward-thinking firm, we strive to be the premier one-stop accounting solution nationwide, where small businesses find financial clarity. Meet the Team Aside from loving to help our clients with all of their tax and accounting needs, the team at Elevation Tax also enjoys many things outside of work that help create a fun and unique environment that keeps us challenged each and everyday. Jeff Bullock, CPA - Director of Operations Since childhood, Jeff has been fascinated by what drives business success, a passion that led him to earn both undergraduate and graduate degrees in Accounting from Brigham Young University. After graduating with a Master of Accountancy in Tax, he started his career at PricewaterhouseCoopers in Denver. While rewarding, the repetitive nature of work on a single tax return line for months prompted him to seek a more dynamic path. This inspired him to found Elevation Tax Group in 2014, a firm dedicated to providing comprehensive tax and accounting services for entrepreneurs and individuals. Outside of work, Jeff enjoys spending time with his wife and four kids. An avid outdoor enthusiast, he's embraced triathlons, competing in multiple full and half Ironman races. A couple of years ago he set a goal to complete the World Marathon Majors. He's finished three of the seven races and aims to conquer the remaining four in the coming years. He loves everything Lego, building, designing, and collecting with his boys! James Setterberg, CPA - Director of Tax It wasn't until James took an accounting class in high school in Franklin, MA that he discovered a clear path for his future career. Once he began his studies at Brigham Young University and took undergraduate accounting courses, he knew this was the field he wanted to pursue.
